calibration_sources: NVIDIA NCCL 2.21+ NVLS (NVLink SHARP) & Quantum-2/3 InfiniBand SHARPv3 In-Switch Reduction Architecture
Ring AllReduce 2(N-1)/N Bandwidth Amplification vs In-Switch 1.0x Tree Aggregation Law
DeepMind DiLoCo / Hierarchical Low-Communication Data Parallelism over Multi-Campus Links

workload_baseline.node_interconnect: NVSwitch 3.0 (900 GB/s) + 8x400Gbps NDR InfiniBand (400 GB/s per node)

tiers.name: Tier 1: Standard NCCL Ring AllReduce (2(N-1) Sequential Hops, 2.0x Network Traffic)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 1: 传统 NCCL Ring 环状 AllReduce (2(N-1) 跳线性延迟墙 + 2倍流量放大)
tiers.collective_mechanism: Logical ring across 2,048 GPUs: Reduce-Scatter (1.0x bytes) + All-Gather (1.0x bytes)

tiers.name: Tier 2: NCCL Double Binary Tree AllReduce (O(log N) Hops, Host-GPU Reduction)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 2: NCCL 双二叉树 (Double Binary Tree) AllReduce (对数跳数 + 仍占 20 个 SM)
tiers.collective_mechanism: Two complementary binary trees over nodes; O(log2 N) latency but still 2.0x NIC traffic & GPU SM add

tiers.name: Tier 3: Intra-Node NVSwitch NVLS + Inter-Node Quantum-2/3 IB SHARPv3 In-Switch Aggregation
tiers.name_zh: Tier 3: 机内 NVSwitch NVLS + 跨机 IB SHARPv3 交换机网内硬件规约 (流量砍半 + 释放 16 个 SM)
tiers.collective_mechanism: NVSwitch ASIC ALU reduces 8 local GPUs + Leaf/Spine IB Switch ASIC reduces across racks (1.0x traffic!)

tiers.name: Tier 4: Hierarchical Communicators (TP=NVLS, DP=IB SHARP) + Cross-DC Low-Freq Outer-Momentum (DiLoCo H=50)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 4: 分层通信域隔离 (TP用NVLS / DP用SHARP) + 跨机房低频外动量同步 (Hierarchical DiLoCo)
tiers.collective_mechanism: Isolates SHARP trees strictly to DP groups (prevents switch tree exhaustion) + H=50 outer sync across DCs
